description: This file contains the implementation of the LunarView class, which manages rendering, physics simulation, and user input handling for a simple LunarLander game on Android. It includes an inner thread class LunarThread that performs the game loop, updates physics based on user interaction and game state, and renders game visuals such as the lander, background, and UI bars.

classes.name: LunarView
classes.description: Custom SurfaceView subclass that handles rendering and input for the LunarLander game. Manages the game thread, user input, and game state.

classes.name: LunarThread
classes.description: Inner class extending Thread, responsible for the main game loop: updating physics, rendering frames, and handling game state transitions.

methods.name: surfaceCreated
methods.description: Starts the game thread when the surface is ready.

methods.name: surfaceDestroyed
methods.description: Signals the game thread to stop when the surface is destroyed.

methods.name: setTextView
methods.description: Assigns a TextView to display game status messages.

methods.name: onKeyDown
methods.description: Delegates key-down events to the game thread for handling game controls.

methods.name: onKeyUp
methods.description: Delegates key-up events to the game thread for handling controls.
